en: Black‑and‑white / tinted historic street view labeled in German, showing a tree‑lined promenade with many pedestrians in early 20th‑century fashion. On the right are ornate multi‑story buildings with shopfronts and striped awnings; on the left is a park‑like avenue. Hills with buildings rise in the background. The red printed title at the top reads "Karlsbad. Am Eingang der alten Wiese."
